meta_description: Gav Fox Plastering in Walsall delivers expert internal and external plastering for homes and businesses. Same-day quotes, quality finishes. Call today.
hero_subhead: From cracked walls to full room renovations, Gav Fox delivers flawless finishes on time and on budget.
services_subhead: Whether you need repair work, new builds, or decorative finishes, we handle every plastering job with precision and care.

services.title: Interior Plastering
services.desc: Skimming, boarding, and finishing walls and ceilings to create smooth, paint-ready surfaces. Ideal for renovations and new extensions.

services.title: External Rendering
services.desc: Weather-resistant external plaster and render to protect and refresh your home's exterior. Long-lasting protection against the elements.

services.title: Artex & Textured Finishes
services.desc: Removal, repair, and application of textured coatings for period properties or modern feature walls.

services.title: Ceiling Repairs & Boarding
services.desc: Fix sagging, cracked, or water-damaged ceilings. We board and skim for a professional finish every time.

services.title: Damp-Proof Treatments
services.desc: Specialist plastering to prevent and repair damp issues, using breathable compounds that protect your walls long-term.

services.title: Decorative Plasterwork
services.desc: Cornicing, coving, and bespoke plaster features to add character and elegance to period and contemporary rooms.

about_pullquote: I started plastering because shoddy workmanship winds me up. Every job gets my best effort.
about_para_1: Gav Fox Plastering has been serving Walsall and the surrounding West Midlands for over 12 years. Built on honest work and attention to detail, the business has completed over 500 jobs — from single-room repairs to large commercial projects. Every plasterer on our team is trained to our standards and carries insurance to give you peace of mind.
about_para_2: We've earned a strong reputation by turning up on time, finishing on time, and leaving your home cleaner than we found it. Our customers appreciate straightforward pricing, no hidden extras, and a tradesperson who listens to what you actually want, not what we think you need.
reviews_heading: What Walsall Customers Say About Gav Fox Plastering

reviews.text: Gav completely transformed our lounge. The walls were a nightmare — cracks everywhere — and he got them perfectly smooth in one go. Professional, tidy, and didn't hang about. Honest bloke. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Had him back for the second time. First job was our hallway, this time he did our kitchen walls ahead of new units. Always reliable, always does quality work. Fair pricing too, which is rare these days.
reviews.author: Christine M.

reviews.text: External render was looking shabby. Gav quoted, got started straightaway, and finished the whole job in three days. Weather's held up brilliantly since. Saved us a fortune compared to other quotes. Really pleased.
reviews.author: David H.
